hypotheses.persona: A single adult who works from home and has a daily early morning water sports hobby (wetsuit, swim goggles, swim cap, mesh bag). The consistent early morning water activity (05:27-05:34) every day of the week, including weekends, combined with structured meal times (dining chair at breakfast, mid-morning, dinner) and midday nap (pillow), points to a home-based workday with a morning water activity. No evidence of a second person. Day 12 (Saturday) shows a relaxed weekend pattern: no early morning water activity, later morning start (picture_frame at 10:00), afternoon dining chair use (14:16, 14:27), and evening relaxation (floor_lamp, phone, waste_bin). This is consistent with a working adult who sleeps in on weekends and does not do the water activity on Saturdays. — The weekend pattern (no early water activity, later start) is exactly what one would expect from a working adult who reserves the early hobby for weekdays. The structured weekday schedule (midday nap, meal times) is more parsimoniously explained by a work-from-home adult than a retiree.
hypotheses.rationale: Day 13 (Sunday) shows no early morning water activity (towel at 05:27 is ambiguous but not the usual gear), and a later start (picture_frame at 13:00, dining_chair at 16:39). This reinforces the weekend pattern of sleeping in and skipping the water hobby. The structured weekday pattern remains consistent.

hypotheses.persona: A retiree with a flexible schedule who enjoys water sports but skips it on weekends. The early morning water activity on weekdays and later weekend start could fit a retiree's flexible schedule. However, the structured meal times and midday nap are also common in retirement. Day 12 (Saturday) shows no early water activity, which could be due to personal preference. The probability remains low because the pattern is more parsimoniously explained by a working adult. — The lack of early water activity on Saturday is not strong evidence for retirement; a working adult would also skip it on weekends. The structured schedule still suggests a working adult.
hypotheses.rationale: Day 13 (Sunday) again shows no early water activity, consistent with a weekend skip. But the structured schedule (midday nap, meal times) is more typical of a work-from-home adult than a retiree. No new evidence to increase probability.
